envelope.description: Separate active tools from model-wait inactivity

body.title: Separate active tools from model-wait inactivity
body.summary: Implement design-local timer/activity policy around the existing ReviewActivityMonitor. Preserve 30-minute true-inactivity grace and no task deadline, while separately tracking active tool identities/elapsed state and deferring inactivity expiry during verified in-flight tools. Keep shared code-review/provider behavior unchanged and report tool-wait diagnostic honestly.
acceptanceChecks: Native and controller execution survive beyond old fixed allowances while meaningful activity continues or a verified tool remains active; no deadlineMs/stallMs/task budget is introduced.
After tool completion normal model-wait inactivity applies; actual idle expiry becomes the coordinator-owned technical failure path and late output cannot commit.
Polling, heartbeats and process presence do not renew grace; tool failures/process exit remain actionable; all clocks/timers/resources stop with the unit/job.

tests.name: Virtual-clock native/controller activity permits long active tools and meaningful progress without fixed deadlines, while true idle waits expire at thirty minutes.
Polling, heartbeat and process liveness do not renew activity; tool completion/failure and late output obey unit cancellation and timer cleanup.
